entities.name: Query heme oxygenase
observations: 107-residue protein with an exact full-length sequence match to curated Bacillus heme-degrading monooxygenases C3PAD1, C3L7Z8, and A0RJE3.
Annotated as heme oxygenase (decyclizing), EC 1.14.14.18; binds heme and iron.
Sequence-based report identifies an ABM domain (PF03992.23), positions 1–76.

entities.name: Heme to biliverdin IXalpha
observations: Heme b is oxidatively degraded to biliverdin IXalpha, carbon monoxide, ferrous iron, and water using molecular oxygen and reducing equivalents supplied by NADPH–hemoprotein reductase.
Reference reaction mapping includes Rhea RHEA:11964, RHEA:11965, and RHEA:21764; EC 1.14.14.18.

entities.name: Heme catabolic process
observations: The enzyme supports bacterial heme utilization by opening the porphyrin macrocycle, releasing iron for uptake.
